subject: MedStrata – request to unlock Tier B pricing & packaging exception (VP/CFO signoff)
messages:
From: Erin Wu <erin@medstrata.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@procure.medstrata.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing request & VPC packaging for MAAP pilot

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the performance numbers looked good. We have an internal procurement cadence this quarter and I need to lock budget quickly if we want to start the MAAP pilot in Q1. A couple of constraints on our side:

- We need a private VPC deployment (data residency + KMS) and an onboarding window in Jan.
- Target first-year spend is roughly $450k ARR (pilot + expanded PoC usage).
- Our procurement team is asking for a pricing floor at Tier B (volume slab) and a starter discount to justify the pilot economics to the board.

Can Redwood do a one-time onboarding credit plus a promotional tiered discount for year 1? If so, please send a short memo (VP/CFO signoff) and terms so I can route it through procurement.

Attaching our internal MAAP requirements doc.

Thanks,
Erin

Attachments: MedStrata_MAAP_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Wu <erin@medstrata.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@procure.medstrata.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 13:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing request & VPC packaging for MAAP pilot

Hi Erin —

Appreciate the clear ask and timeline. We're excited to partner on MAAP. Preliminary response so you can advance internally:

- We can support a Private/VPC deployment with KMS and the onboarding window in Jan (subject to capacity scheduling).
- Proposed commercial: one-time onboarding credit of $25k + a promotional 18% discount off list for the first 12 months at Tier B commitment ($450k ARR target).
- Term sheet (draft) attached — includes service SLOs and a scoped deployment plan.

Would you like me to route this as a formal exception memo to our Sales Leadership + Finance for VP/CFO signoff? If you can confirm the expected committed ARR and the anticipated start date, I’ll push for expedited approval.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0118

Attachments: redwood_term_sheet_v2.pdf (draft term sheet)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:04:00 -08:00
Subject: MedStrata pricing unlock request — ask for VP/CFO exception (deal MS-2026-117)

Marissa / Markus —

Requesting a pricing & packaging exception signoff for MedStrata (deal MS-2026-117). Summary below plus attachments. I need a decision to get this routed through procurement by EOD Monday.

External ask (from Erin Wu, procurement): Private VPC deployment + one-time onboarding credit and promotional tiered discount at Tier B for year 1. Expected committed ARR ~ $450k (pilot → scale plan).

What I'm proposing (recommended):
- One-time onboarding credit: $25,000 (applied to first invoice).
- Promotional discount: 18% off list for first 12 months on Tier B committed volume (reduces first-year unit price).
- Commitment term: 12 months (pilot + operational ramp).
- Packaging change: Private / VPC deployment with standard dedicated capacity SLA; Redwood to include limited ramp burst capacity for first 3 months.

Business rationale:
- Strategic reference potential: MedStrata is a high-visibility payer/analytics platform in our target healthcare segment — strong case for a reference + case study if pilot converts.
- Upside: If we secure the pilot and benchmarks pass, expected 2–3x expansion into product teams within 12–18 months (estimated TCV $1.2M+ over 24 months).
- Competitive risk: Two other vendors (closed-source) are offering deep bundled discounts; to win this we need a defensible promotional concession now.

Risk / mitigations:
- Price erosion: Limit promo to first 12 months and tie discount to a committed ARR floor ($450k).
- Operational impact: Require procurement of dedicated capacity and schedule onboarding dates; SRE to approve capacity window before final signoff.

Ask of leadership:
- Marissa: approval to offer the one-time credit and 18% promo (or counter).
- Markus: CFO signoff for revenue recognition and P&L carveouts (onboarding credit treatment + discount schedule).

Attachments included: redwood_term_sheet_v2.pdf (draft commercial terms), MedStrata_MAAP_pricing_request.pdf (customer request). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

If approved, I'll send an updated term sheet to Erin and Sam and coordinate signatures (DocuSign). Please respond with the decision and any edits.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MedStrata pricing unlock request — ask for VP/CFO exception (deal MS-2026-117)

Karthik / Marissa —

Thanks — reviewed the ask and the attached draft term sheet. I approve a modified exception under the following conditions:

1) Reduce promotional discount to 15% (not 18%) for year 1.
2) Extend minimum commitment term to 18 months (to protect revenue recognition and amortize onboarding credit).
3) Onboarding credit of $20k (versus $25k) and applied as a credit against the first two invoices.
4) Require a signed purchase order and an explicit capacity reservation calendar (SRE confirmation) before executing.

Rationale: the downgrade in discount / extension of term preserves net present value while still providing a competitive offer to win this strategic customer. Finance will prepare a brief memo for the revenue treatment and any carveouts required.

Marissa — please confirm if Sales accepts the adjustments so I can clear the final DocuSign envelope. Karthik — once Marissa confirms, please update the term sheet and send to Erin + Sam and include the PO deadline (COB Wed).

-Markus
Markus Klein | VP Finance & FP&A | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
